Corollary
[Parallel Transport Determines the Connection] ↗ thm:parallel-transport-determines-covariant-diff 1. ch4:4.35

Let $X,Y$ be smooth vector fields. For $p\in M$ and any smooth curve $\gamma \colon I o M$ satisfying $\gamma (0)=p$ and $\gamma '(0)=X_p$, egin{equation} abla _XY|_p=\lim _{h o 0} rac{P_{h0}^\gamma Y(\gamma (h))-Y_p}{h}. ag {4.25} \end{equation}

Proof

\sketch Restrict $Y$ to $\gamma $. The defining property of covariant differentiation along curves gives $ abla _XY|_p=D_t(Y\circ \gamma )(0)$; apply Theorem 23.

□

A smooth vector or tensor field on $M$ is parallel when it is parallel along every smooth curve.
